==Notes==
*Smooth Criminal will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, Smooth Criminal is [[disable]]d for 20 seconds after the copy effect ends.

==Trivia==
*[[wikipedia:Smooth Criminal|Smooth Criminal]] is the title of a song from Michael Jackson's album [[wikipedia:Bad (album)|Bad]].
**The [[skill icon]] depicts a disguised [[Asura]] performing one scene from the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h_D3VFfhvs4&ab_channel=michaeljacksonVEVO Smooth Criminal music video], with several small Asuras in the background.
